assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An approved Code Connect-style mapping from each selected published Figma component to an existing coded component, preserving properties.
assessments.rationale: It translates Figma designs into implementation, but the requested outcome is linking already-existing code components to published design components.
It obtains selected published-component suggestions, scans the codebase for matching components, presents matches for approval, and creates mappings with property-aware component links.
